description.en: Puts the active camera back at the field (RPG) camera position for the character the player controls (CMND_GET_RPG_CAMERA_POS, then CMND_SET_CAMERA_POS and CMND_SET_CAMERA_REF), and calls CMND_COPY_EXIT_CAMERA(1). The events call it at their end, before handing control back.

examples.case: End of an event (real usage, from ev42010100.nut; the Shift-JIS motion name is replaced by a variable here)
